intentional_modifications.category: LF02 Causal Source Fix: Distinct Serialized Same-SKU Line Deduplication and Canonical Sorting
intentional_modifications.justification: Replaced unconditional duplicate line guard on {ProductId, ProductUnitId} with physical unit uniqueness validation across all lines (rejecting duplicates with sales.serial_selected_twice) while restricting duplicate line rejection to commodity/untracked lines (InventoryUnitIds.Count == 0). Canonicalized sorting in MatchesExistingSalePayloadAsync.

intentional_modifications.category: LF02 Causal Desktop Adapter Fix: Cart Line Grouping by Unit Price and Price Override
intentional_modifications.justification: Group cart items by ProductId, ProductUnitId, UnitPrice, OverridePrice, and OverrideReason so lines with different price overrides are preserved on separate lines rather than erroneously throwing sales.inconsistent_pricing or failing downstream validation.

intentional_modifications.category: LF02 Dedicated Named Behavioral Proof Tests
intentional_modifications.justification: Added 4 named behavioral tests verifying distinct serialized units of the same SKU succeed on separate lines, different price overrides succeed, duplicate serialized units are rejected with sales.serial_selected_twice, and duplicate commodity lines are rejected with sales.duplicate_line.
